title: Love Your Enemies
short_answer: Jesus taught that believers should love even their enemies.
summary: In the Sermon on the Mount Jesus commanded followers to love their enemies and pray for those who persecute them.

title: Greatest Commandment
short_answer: The greatest commandment is to love God and love your neighbor.
summary: Jesus said the greatest commandment is to love the Lord with all your heart, soul, and mind, and the second is to love your neighbor as yourself.
